description: This PHP class 'MigrationAPI' serves as an API controller for handling migration-related requests during the installation or upgrade process of the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract REST controller and provides endpoints for fetching version information and executing migration steps.

classes.name: MigrationAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for handling migration version retrieval and execution during system upgrades.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve migration version information based on current version and optional inclusion flag.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to execute migration steps, either for a specific version or between two versions, and logs the actions.
